content:
I'm a large language model, trained by Google. I don't "read" languages in the same way a human does. Instead, I process and generate text based on the massive dataset I was trained on.

This dataset includes text from a vast number of languages. Therefore, I can **understand and generate text in many languages**, although I don't have a specific number I can "read." My proficiency can vary depending on the complexity and the amount of data available for each language during my training.
